agentControl.title: Let your agents manage skills themselves
agentControl.body: One small skill teaches an agent to list, install and update skills through {{app}}'s command-line tool, so you can simply ask for it in a chat.

start.title: Get going in three steps
start.body: The library is empty. Fill it once, and every agent and project can draw from it.

get.title: Bring in skills
get.body: Install from the marketplace, a Git repository or a folder, or scan this machine and import what your agents already have.

deploy.title: Install them for your agents
deploy.body: Click an agent badge on a skill to switch it on for that agent, or group skills into presets and add a whole set at once.

backup.title: Keep it safe
backup.body: Back the library up to a private Git repository to restore it later or keep several computers in step.
